findings.title: Establish image-input support before switching the shared reviewer
findings.problem: REVIEW_MODEL also serves image-bearing code reviews and visual-content gates. This switches all of those paths to the DeepSeek endpoint without establishing that it can inspect images. The image tests mock fetch and return a successful verdict regardless of model capabilities; they verify serialization, not compatibility. I could not verify this endpoint's live input modalities from the supplied change.
findings.failure_scenario: A PR changes a canonical PNG, or a diagram review submits image_url parts. If this endpoint is text-only, OpenRouter rejects the request and the existing visual-review path stops working. If image parts are discarded upstream instead, a verdict could be accepted without the reviewer inspecting the visual.
findings.fix: Verify the exact endpoint's image-input capabilities before making it the shared reviewer. Retain a verified vision-capable, cross-vendor reviewer for image-bearing requests if necessary, and add an integration check that detects unsupported image input rather than assuming success from a mocked completion.

assessment: The parser changes remain fail-closed and have meaningful regression tests. The global reviewer migration leaves one critical integration concern unresolved: compatibility with the existing image-review gates.
